entrypoints.summary: The report web application accepts a user-supplied HTTP(S) URL at POST /submit and forwards it to the bot.
The bot creates and visits a premium encrypted secret paste, then navigates the same page to the submitted URL with the keyless paste URL in a from parameter.

affected_components.role: Builds WebCrypto import/decrypt context from receiver properties.
Returns stored paste objects through Express JSONP.
Creates the secret paste and reuses the page for attacker navigation.
Constructs an RSA-OAEP private JWK and receives the exfiltrated opener URL.

impact.affected_asset: Encrypted secret paste content and its fragment-held decryption key.
impact.attacker_capability: An attacker who can submit a report URL can cause the bot to process an attacker-controlled multi-window chain and collect the privileged browser's secret-paste URL.
impact.security_effect: Cross-site script execution in the secret-paste browser context and disclosure of the secret paste URL's fragment decryption key.

causal_trace.summary: A submitted URL is accepted by the report application and passed to visit(url), causing the privileged browser workflow to navigate to attacker-controlled content after it has visited the secret paste.

The client crypto helper constructs WebCrypto import/decrypt parameters from this.name and this.additionalData; the writeup attributes unbound decrypt-callback receiver semantics to attacker-controllable window state and describes substituting a compatible RSA-OAEP key to decrypt fixed ciphertext into chosen markup.

The paste API emits JSONP through res.jsonp; the writeup describes a callback expression that deletes DOMPurify.isSupported, so sanitization becomes a no-op before rendered HTML insertion. It further describes injecting a base URL and invoking the page's nonce-bearing relative JSONP loader, rebasing that loader to attacker origin because the CSP lacks base-uri.

Attacker-origin script reads opener.location.href after history navigation returns the original tab to the secret paste, exposing the full secret-paste URL including its fragment decryption key; the supplied collection server logs that URL.

failure.operation: JSONP callback evaluation deletes DOMPurify.isSupported, followed by base-URL rebasing of a nonce-bearing relative script loader

primary_invariant.statement: Cryptographic algorithm parameters, sanitizer support state, and nonce-authorized script origins must not be controllable by untrusted navigation state, JSONP callback syntax, or attacker-injected document base URLs before rendered paste content is inserted.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The documented chain uses an unbound crypto method with ambient receiver state, JSONP callback evaluation to mutate DOMPurify support state, and absence of CSP base-uri to rebase a nonce-bearing relative loader.

quality.review_notes: Primary application, bot, crypto-helper, and exploit-server artifacts were inspected. The paste template was supplied but its readable extraction was not available; claims about its sanitizer sink and nonce-bearing loader are writeup-grounded. No corrective patch or recorded successful execution is present. The author reports crypto-stage retry behavior and browser-version sensitivity, including failure of the secret-stealing portion on Firefox 106+.

remediation.invariant_restored: Untrusted navigation and response parameters cannot select WebCrypto behavior, disable sanitization, rebase privileged script loads, or read the secret-paste URL through a retained opener/history relationship.
mitigation_classes: Bind crypto helper methods or pass explicit immutable cryptographic context rather than ambient receiver state
Replace JSONP with a non-executable data response and reject callback expressions
Preserve sanitizer support state and do not allow data-loading paths to mutate it
Set CSP base-uri 'none' or a trusted origin and avoid nonce-authorized relative loaders whose base can be changed
Break unnecessary opener/history relationships in the bot navigation workflow

target.component: paste rendering API, client cryptography, and admin-bot workflow
